obligations.text: there is no mortgage or dispute on the premises.

obligations.summary: Party A will lease its premises and attached facilities at the specified location to Party B.
obligations.text: Party A will lease to Party B the premises and attached facilities all owned by Party A itself, which is located at the 16th floor of National Development Bank Tower.

obligations.summary: Party A must attach copies of the ownership certificate and its business license.

obligations.summary: Party B must negotiate settlement of the liquidation group's administration and utility fees.
obligations.text: Party B is responsible for negotiating the settlement of relative fees occurred by the Bankruptcy Liquidation Group, in which the occurred fees include: administration fees, water, electricity, gas etc.
evidenceSpans: Party B is responsible for negotiating the settlement of relative fees occurred by the Bankruptcy Liquidation Group, in which the occurred fees include: administration fees, water, electricity, gas etc.

obligations.summary: Party A must use its best efforts to coordinate the handover with Party B.
obligations.text: Party A should use its best efforts to coordinate with Party B during the interchange.
evidenceSpans: Party A should use its best efforts to coordinate with Party B during the interchange.

obligations.summary: Party B must return the premises at lease expiry.
obligations.text: Party B should return the house to Party A.
evidenceSpans: Party B should return the house to Party A.

obligations.summary: Party B must pay a daily fine of 200% of the lease fee and incurred fees for delayed return.
obligations.text: If the return is delayed by Party B, 200% of the lease fee per day and the incurred fee should be paid to party A as overdue fine.
evidenceSpans: If the return is delayed by Party B, 200% of the lease fee per day and the incurred fee should be paid to party A as overdue fine.

obligations.summary: Party A must provide the specified month for decoration.
obligations.text: Party A agrees to offer one month for decoration, effective from July 1, 2008 to July 31, 2008.
evidenceSpans: Party A agrees to offer one month for decoration, effective from July 1, 2008 to July 31, 2008.

obligations.summary: Party A must bear water, electricity and similar fees during the decoration period.
obligations.text: while Party A should bear the fee of water, electricity, etc.
evidenceSpans: while Party A should bear the fee of water, electricity, etc.

obligations.summary: Party B must pay monthly rent at the specified per-square-meter rate from August 1, 2008.
obligations.text: Rental fee should be ￥45.00 per month for each square meter starting from August 1, 2008.
evidenceSpans: Rental fee should be ￥45.00 per month for each square meter starting from August 1, 2008.

obligations.summary: As written, Party A must pay the specified rent and deposit within three working days of signing.
obligations.text: Party A should pay ￥400,000.00 as rental fee and ￥100,000.00 as deposits within 3 working days after the contract is signed.
evidenceSpans: Party A should pay ￥400,000.00 as rental fee and ￥100,000.00 as deposits within 3 working days after the contract is signed.
obligations.deadline: within 3 working days after the contract is signed

obligations.summary: Party A must deduct monthly rent from Party B's prepaid rent on the fifth, subject to the stated payment condition.
obligations.text: Party A will deduct the rental fee per month from the total rental fee paid by Party B on the 5th of each month if the rental fee is paid off
evidenceSpans: Party A will deduct the rental fee per month from the total rental fee paid by Party B on the 5th of each month if the rental fee is paid off

obligations.summary: Party B must pay Party A rent on the fifth of each month without delay.
obligations.text: Party B pays the rental fee to Party A on the 5th of each month without any delay.
evidenceSpans: Party B pays the rental fee to Party A on the 5th of each month without any delay.

obligations.action: Credit rent and deposit to purchase
obligations.summary: Party A must credit rent and deposit toward the purchase if the stated purchase conditions are met.
obligations.text: the rental fee and deposit will be included in the total amount to purchase the premises aforementioned.
evidenceSpans: the rental fee and deposit will be included in the total amount to purchase the premises aforementioned.

obligations.summary: Party A must issue an authority-recognized invoice after payment.
obligations.text: Party A should offer the invoice recognized by the relevant authority after receiving the payment.
evidenceSpans: Party A should offer the invoice recognized by the relevant authority after receiving the payment.

obligations.summary: Party B must pay all water, electricity, gas and premises administration fees during the rental term.
obligations.text: During the rental term, Party B should bear all the fees incurred for water, electricity, gas and premises administration.
evidenceSpans: During the rental term, Party B should bear all the fees incurred for water, electricity, gas and premises administration.

obligations.summary: Party A must separately bear its taxes under authority regulations.
obligations.text: Both Parties should bear the tax separately according to the regulation of authority.
evidenceSpans: Both Parties should bear the tax separately according to the regulation of authority.

obligations.summary: Party B must separately bear its taxes under authority regulations.
obligations.text: Both Parties should bear the tax separately according to the regulation of authority.
evidenceSpans: Both Parties should bear the tax separately according to the regulation of authority.

obligations.summary: Party A must repair damage arising from quality problems, natural damage or disasters.
obligations.text: In case the premise and attached facilities are damaged by quality problems, natural damages or disasters, Party A will be responsible for repair and must pay the relevant expenses.
evidenceSpans: In case the premise and attached facilities are damaged by quality problems, natural damages or disasters, Party A will be responsible for repair and must pay the relevant expenses.

obligations.summary: Party A must pay the repair expenses for the specified damage.
obligations.text: Party A will be responsible for repair and must pay the relevant expenses.
evidenceSpans: Party A will be responsible for repair and must pay the relevant expenses.

obligations.summary: Party B must take good care of the premises.
obligations.text: should take good care of the premises.
evidenceSpans: should take good care of the premises.

obligations.summary: Party B must compensate damage to the premises and facilities caused by its fault or negligence on failure to comply.
obligations.text: Otherwise, Party B will be responsible to compensate any damages of the premises and attached facilities caused by its fault and negligence.
evidenceSpans: Otherwise, Party B will be responsible to compensate any damages of the premises and attached facilities caused by its fault and negligence.

obligations.summary: Party A must notify Party B of an intended sale within two months before expiry.
obligations.text: Within two months before the contract expires, Party A will notify Party B if it intends to sell the premises.
evidenceSpans: Within two months before the contract expires, Party A will notify Party B if it intends to sell the premises.
obligations.deadline: Within two months before the contract expires

obligations.summary: The breaching party must compensate losses not covered by the default fine.
obligations.text: In case the default fine is not sufficient to cover the loss suffered by the faultless Party, the Party in breach should pay additional compensation to the other Party:
evidenceSpans: In case the default fine is not sufficient to cover the loss suffered by the faultless Party, the Party in breach should pay additional compensation to the other Party:

obligations.summary: Party B must give written notice one month in advance if it intends to continue renting.
obligations.text: If Party B intends to continue to rent, it shall inform party A in written form one months in advance.
evidenceSpans: If Party B intends to continue to rent, it shall inform party A in written form one months in advance.

obligations.summary: Party A guarantees the good condition of the premises, facilities and equipment.
obligations.text: Party A should guarantee that the premises and attached facilities and equipment are in good condition.
evidenceSpans: Party A should guarantee that the premises and attached facilities and equipment are in good condition.

obligations.summary: Party B must return the premises, facilities and equipment at the end of the lease.
obligations.text: Party B should return the premises and attached facilities and equipment to Party A when the lease contract comes to an end.
evidenceSpans: Party B should return the premises and attached facilities and equipment to Party A when the lease contract comes to an end.
obligations.deadline: when the lease contract comes to an end

obligations.summary: Party A must keep the premises and facilities sound and free of retained items or interference with normal use.
obligations.text: Party A should keep the house and attached facilities in sound condition, without any items retained, or impact the normal use of the house.
evidenceSpans: Party A should keep the house and attached facilities in sound condition, without any items retained, or impact the normal use of the house.

obligations.summary: Party A must pay twice the rental for the remaining days if it breaches the contract by demanding the house back early.
obligations.text: If Party A violates the contract and demands back the house in advance, Party A should pay twice the rental as penalty based on the days remaining in the contract.
evidenceSpans: If Party A violates the contract and demands back the house in advance, Party A should pay twice the rental as penalty based on the days remaining in the contract.

obligations.summary: Party A must pay additional compensation if its penalty is insufficient.
obligations.text: If the penalty is not sufficient to cover such items, Party A shall bear additional compensation.
evidenceSpans: If the penalty is not sufficient to cover such items, Party A shall bear additional compensation.

obligations.summary: Party A must compensate Party B if flaws or illegality of the house attributable to Party A make the contract ineffective.
obligations.text: If the contract is caused by Party A to be ineffective due to flaws or illegality of the house, Party A should compensate for the loss of Party B.
evidenceSpans: If the contract is caused by Party A to be ineffective due to flaws or illegality of the house, Party A should compensate for the loss of Party B.

obligations.summary: Party B must pay twice the rent for the remaining days if it terminates early without consent.
obligations.text: During the leasing period, if Party B terminates the lease in advance without the consent of Party A，Party B should pay a penalty of twice the rent based on the days remaining in the contract.
evidenceSpans: During the leasing period, if Party B terminates the lease in advance without the consent of Party A，Party B should pay a penalty of twice the rent based on the days remaining in the contract.

obligations.summary: The text assigns Party A additional compensation where the early termination penalty is insufficient.
obligations.text: If the penalty is not sufficient to cover such items, Party A shall bear additional compensation
evidenceSpans: If the penalty is not sufficient to cover such items, Party A shall bear additional compensation

obligations.summary: Party B must pay any amount not covered by the deposit through other means.
obligations.text: If the deposit is insufficient，Party B should pay the remainder in other ways.
evidenceSpans: If the deposit is insufficient，Party B should pay the remainder in other ways.

obligations.summary: Party A must refund overpaid rent upon force majeure termination, using actual usage and daily proration for less than one month.
obligations.text: If the contract is terminated for the foregoing reason, the rent will be calculated in accordance with the actual usage time. If it is less than one month，the rent will be charged based on the days according to the principle of returning the overcharge and demand payment of the shortage.
evidenceSpans: If the contract is terminated for the foregoing reason, the rent will be calculated in accordance with the actual usage time. If it is less than one month，the rent will be charged based on the days according to the principle of returning the overcharge and demand payment of the shortage.

obligations.summary: Party B must pay rent shortfalls based on actual usage, prorated daily for less than one month, upon force majeure termination.
obligations.text: If the contract is terminated for the foregoing reason, the rent will be calculated in accordance with the actual usage time. If it is less than one month，the rent will be charged based on the days according to the principle of returning the overcharge and demand payment of the shortage.

obligations.summary: Party A must negotiate disputes arising during performance.
